verdict.rationale: Plan review is a fair question for a coding-agent orchestrator, so the axis applies. The evidence describes no plan-review or approval gate. In the prompt-first flow the agent 'starts working on your prompt immediately', and review happens afterward on diffs in the Changes tab. Notifications when an agent 'pauses for your input' are an adjacent status feature, not a documented plan-approval step.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made
